'''IsoTech offices''' were the headquarters of IsoTech, a front company owned by [[Reom]]. They were located on [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
